title: DPD Coefficient Estimator
text: Estimate memory-polynomial coefficients for digital predistortion, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Desired amplitude gain (dB)} sets the desired amplitude gain in dB, {Polynomial type}, {Degree} sets the memory-polynomial degree, {Memory depth} sets the memory-polynomial depth, {Algorithm} sets the estimation algorithm Least, {Forgetting factor source} sets the source of forgetting, {Forgetting factor}, {Initial coefficient estimate} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: PA In
ports.summary: Power amplifier baseband-equivalent input column vector

ports.name: PA Out
ports.summary: Power amplifier baseband-equivalent output column vector

ports.name: Forgetting Factor
ports.summary: Forgetting factor scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Desired amplitude gain (dB)
params.values: Desired amplitude gain in dB 10 (default) | scalar

params.name: Polynomial type
params.values: Polynomial type Memory polynomial (default) | Cross-term memory polynomial

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: Estimation algorithm Least squares (default) | Recursive least squares

params.name: Forgetting factor source
params.values: Source of forgetting factor Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Forgetting factor
params.values: Forgetting factor 0.99 (default) | scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
